card.description: Household items and where one city's sorting guide says each one goes. Most items follow their material, but some do not.
card.source: Made for the Sprite Lab 2 app examples.

context.potentialUses: Learn how items are sorted for recycling, compost, and trash.
context.potentialMisuses: Every city has its own rules. This data follows one made-up city, so it can be wrong where you live.

fields.description: What the item is made of: plastic, paper, metal, glass, or food.
Whether the item is clean or dirty with food or grease.
Whether the item bends like a bag or wrapper: no or yes.
Where the item belongs: Recycle, Compost, or Trash.
